# Explain supported product value

Communicate product value through credible claims and an appropriate editorial voice.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Use for announcements, landing-page copy, positioning and customer explanations.

Example request:

> Announce booking exports for members; preserve that background scheduling has not shipped.

Expected result: Customer-facing value grounded in actual behaviour, with stronger claims separated for validation.

## A concrete example

This illustrative example starts from the source facts below.

**Source facts and constraints:** Members can download bookings on demand. Automatic daily scheduling has not shipped.

**Before**

> Automatically export all your bookings every day.

**After**

> Download your bookings when you need them.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.7.0 --skill write-marketing-content
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/write-marketing-content/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/write-marketing-content/references/marketing.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.

## Practices behind this skill

This skill connects audience needs to supported product value, incorporating factual checks and voice-sensitive editing informed by Humanizer and Plain Language Editor. The resulting copy should be engaging while remaining accountable to actual product behaviour.

- [Microsoft plain-word guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/style-guide/word-choice/use-simple-words-concise-sentences)
- [Google jargon guidance](https://developers.google.com/style/jargon)

The [source-to-guidance map](../../standards/framework-evidence.md) explains how these sources inform the skill and which decisions are local.
